**[MOD INFO:]**

Champion: Nasus (Base)

Version: 1.0

Author: Sirdy

Changes: Texture, Animations, Sfxs and Vfxs, VO, Icon and Loadscreen.

Voice Languages: PT-BR, EN US. (Some voice lines were created using AI.)

**[Description:]**

Number of stacks of the Siphoning Strike (Q) skill required for each transformation:

| SSJ01 = 150

| SSJ03 = 300

| SSJ04 (DAIMA) = 450

| SSJ GOD = 590

| SSJ BLUE = 690

| MUI = 1000

Manual Transformation Version -> Transform using /Taunt or Ctrl+2 when reaching the required number of Stacks for each form.

Automatic Transformation Version -> Transforms automatically when there are enough Stacks for each form; cannot be canceled. For each odd death ("0/1, 0/3"), receives an angel's halo; works correctly only in the automatic version.
